label: Bible Study
prompt: And he is the _____ of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
verse: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
note: Christ is head of the body, the church — first in creation and first from the dead.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and _____ in the Holy Ghost.
verse: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
note: God's kingdom isn't about menus — it's righteousness, peace, and joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Judah is a lion's _____: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
verse: Judah is a lion's whelp: from the prey, my son, thou art gone up: he stooped down, he couched as a lion, and as an old lion; who shall rouse him up?
note: Jacob's blessing calls Judah a lion's whelp — and Revelation 5:5 later hails 'the Lion of the tribe of Juda.'

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for _____?
verse: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, Doth Job fear God for nought?
note: Satan's question: does Job serve God only because God pays well? The whole book answers it.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye _____ ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
verse: Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.
note: Don't add, don't 'diminish' — Moses' rule for God's word, echoed in the Bible's closing warning (Revelation 22:18–19).
